data.name: Berserk Fury Stain
data.description: When you're hit by a critical hit or drop below half your maximum hit points, you must succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or become enraged for %2 rounds. You gain the benefits of this manifestation's gift, but you're completely out of control, making melee attacks against the nearest creature (roll randomly if there are multiple targets).|15+PrometheanManifestationLevel|PrometheanManifestationLevel
